name: AAG Image Job
description: Read status, request safe targeted cancellation, or explicitly resume only the incomplete children of one governed multi-image parent owned by the current conversation. Resume is a new-user-turn action and never an automatic retry. It cannot clear queues, restart services, browse files, or run arbitrary recovery.

action.description: Required exact value: status, cancel, or resume. Resume is batch-parent-only and requires new user input.

job_id.description: Required AAG image job ID returned by AAG Image Task.

routing.action: inspect resume or cancel an existing AAG image job
routing.operation: get status, resume, or cancel by job identifier
